name: Laya
description: Answers typed choice, score, and yes/no questions about text in 100+ languages in one forward pass, via Python, CLI, a self-hosted HTTP server, or MCP, for routing and triage.

skills.name: Typed Decisions
skills.description: Returns choice, score, and yes/no answers with probabilities for many questions in one forward pass.

skills.name: Language Router
skills.description: Detects script and language and routes each request to the English or multilingual checkpoint.

skills.name: Workflow Presets
skills.description: Ships presets for model routing, prompt guardrails, content moderation, ticket triage, and email triage.

skills.name: Self-Hosted HTTP Server
skills.description: Serves the router over HTTP on the Jev-compatible POST /v1/systemone protocol with laya-serve.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: Exposes decisions to MCP clients through the optional laya-mcp-server.
